evidence.title: Palestinian woman and NBC News team attacked by masked Israeli settlers in West Bank

occurrences.checkable_against: Lawahez Jabari's statement and NBC News video footage
occurrences.quote_span: “Suddenly a car came to us,” she said after receiving medical care. “The settlers had sticks. I saw a gun, but they didn’t use the gun.”
occurrences.speaker: Lawahez Jabari
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: Matt Bradley's statement, NBC News footage and clinic treatment records
occurrences.quote_span: “They jumped out, beat us, then jumped back in the car,” said NBC News international correspondent Matt Bradley, who was hit twice in the arm and later treated at a nearby clinic.
occurrences.speaker: Matt Bradley
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News video footage of the Jalud attack
occurrences.quote_span: A masked man in a blue tracksuit, holding a stick, was leaning out of the rear passenger window as the vehicle approached.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: Palestinian Red Crescent patient and transport records
occurrences.quote_span: Abdullah, 51, who was on the ground after the attack, was taken for medical care by the Red Crescent.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: Aida Ahmed Abdullah's testimony and property/displacement records in Jalud
occurrences.quote_span: Abdullah said they had been driven out of their home by Israeli settlers , and the team was walking down a hill toward the house.
occurrences.speaker: Aida Ahmed Abdullah
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News video footage and police/security incident reports
occurrences.quote_span: When the car stopped, at least four men in dark clothes and with their faces covered leaped out, hitting Abdullah and the crew with sticks and throwing rocks at them.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News personnel injury and medical treatment records
occurrences.quote_span: Two additional members of the NBC News team — a cameraman and producer — were also injured and were treated following the attack.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: Israeli military and Israel Border Police incident statement and medical records
occurrences.quote_span: Her injuries were not life-threatening, according to an Israeli military and Israel Border Police statement.
occurrences.speaker: Israeli military and Israel Border Police
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News video footage and vehicle registration records
occurrences.quote_span: A gray car with Israeli license plates then drove in reverse up the hill toward them, video of the incident shows.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: Khaldoon Eid's statement and location/video records
occurrences.quote_span: “We didn’t expect that — that they would come to attack,” he said. “We were in the middle of a Palestinian area next to Palestinian houses.”
occurrences.speaker: Khaldoon Eid
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News assignment records and video footage of the Jalud incident
occurrences.quote_span: Three members of an NBC team were interviewing Aida Ahmed Abdullah and her family in the Palestinian town of Jalud, near Nablus, when the attack occurred.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News video and reporting records, Palestinian Red Crescent and Israeli security incident records
occurrences.quote_span: Masked Israeli settlers attacked and injured a Palestinian woman and members of an NBC News team reporting in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on Saturday.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: Khaldoon Eid's statement and NBC News assignment records
occurrences.quote_span: Camera operator Khaldoon Eid, who lives in the West Bank, said he was surprised the attack occurred in the middle of the village.
occurrences.speaker: Khaldoon Eid
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News video, equipment damage records and vehicle inspection records
occurrences.quote_span: Producer Lawahez Jabari described how the car rushed up the hill before its occupants beat members of the team and damaged camera equipment and one of the crew’s vehicles.
occurrences.speaker: Lawahez Jabari
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers

occurrences.checkable_against: Hospital admission and clinical records for Aida Ahmed Abdullah
occurrences.quote_span: According to her husband, Mahmoud Toubasi, Abdullah’s condition had improved but she remained in the hospital Saturday night.
occurrences.speaker: Mahmoud Toubasi
occurrences.subject: Masked Israeli settlers
